title: NLTK: StreamBackedCorpusView constructor os.stat leaks out-of-root file existence, size, and mtime bypassing pathsec…
description: NLTK versions 3.10.0 through 3.10.3 contain a vulnerability in the StreamBackedCorpusView constructor where the os.stat call on a file path string leaks metadata about files outside the allowed sandbox roots. This bypasses the pathsec enforcement intended to restrict filesystem access, exposing file existence, exact size, and modification time without disclosing file content. The vulnerability requires an attacker to influence the file path string passed to the constructor. The issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.
